aboutParagraphs: Next Door Plumbing Pros is a local, family-run plumbing company based in central Indiana, serving Bloomington and the surrounding area. We handle the plumbing problems homeowners call about most: hidden leaks, water heaters, water softeners and treatment, copper repipes and gas lines.
Customers know our plumber, Chris, by name. On Yelp and Nextdoor they describe same-day help with leaks, problems in older homes solved quickly, and work that's polite, professional and fast.
Plumbing problems don't keep business hours, so we don't either. We're open 24 hours a day. Call or send a request any time, and we'll get back to you.

faq.q: Do you handle plumbing emergencies after hours?
faq.a: Yes. We're open 24 hours a day, including nights and weekends. Call (812) 558-1967. If water is actively leaking, shut off the main water valve first to limit the damage.

faq.q: How do I protect my outdoor faucets this winter?
faq.a: Before the first hard freeze, disconnect garden hoses from your wall hydrants and yard hydrants. A hose left attached can trap water that freezes, cracks the hose bib and causes a leak inside the wall. If your home has an indoor shutoff for the outdoor faucet, close it and drain the line.
